what_happened.line: The Planning Board took no substantive votes; the only motion was to adjourn.
Members went through a new grid-style draft of off-street parking and loading requirements, with revisions to follow.
The board discussed exemptions in the draft earth removal bylaw, including fill, foundations and septic work, and was asked to send marked-up comments.
Members began discussing changes to the solar bylaw and were asked to send ideas to the planner, likely for a spring effort with a try for fall.
The board set the July 22 agenda (Unitil, earth removal, economic development) and said a construction bond hearing would likely be scheduled for the 26th.

why_it_matters: The drafts under review would set rules for parking, solar installations and earth removal on private land, so any of them reaching Town Meeting would change what property owners and developers may build or do.
Nothing was decided at this meeting, so there is still time for residents to comment before the bylaws go to a public hearing.
